protocol.search_order: For each numeric proposal, branch slot0 then1; one request per active layout in each round. Stop a case after3/3 fresh confirmations or3 failed confirmation groups.
protocol.confirmation: Replay the exact selected connection and both joint vectors three fresh times; no re-solving or numeric adjustment.
protocol.geometry: Two blocked cells receive CPU geometry diagnostics only; no guard relaxation or automatic admission.
protocol.preservation: Replay24 original successes and5 confirmed recovery recipes with source-bound unchanged action and joint branch.
protocol.evaluation_scope: Historical fixed-grid recipe development, not held out or a new policy score
protocol.scope: Bounded development search on four unresolved historical fixed-grid locations, with two fixed-base clearance cases receiving CPU geometry audit only. Twenty-nine successful recipes keep their exact actions and admitted joints. Ninety-six unique numeric proposals per searched location each offer two distinct IK branch slots; bucket positions, bucket-facing yaw and native64/v3 stay fixed. A discovered recipe needs three fresh nominal captures. No policy fitting, promotion, new positions, noise, 128-step qualification, transit learning, hardware or UI changes.
